FRONTSP.reason: Top score rests on one government buyer, L1 tender pricing and a railway capex cycle the market already prices at ~28x FY26. CFO unverified (net cash flow -1.7 Cr). The RDSO moat is real but thin.

GULPOLY.reason: The P/E of 6 sits on peak, policy-set ethanol spreads; TTM PAT (~170 Cr) is well above FY26. Allocation cuts after E20, grain costs and sorbitol oversupply could reverse it. The low multiple prices in the cyclicality.

SRM.reason: Cheap, but a ~11% PAT margin is high for EPC and normalisation is the base case. FY25 had a -116 Cr working-capital build, order-book figures conflict, and DII is exiting. Verify receivables and arbitration.

JSLL.reason: A 44% EBITDA margin in healthcare, ~Rs 51 Cr FCF against Rs 222 Cr PAT, and growth built on treatment claims under AYUSH ad rules. Margin and cash quality need forensic work before trusting this score.

544406.reason: SME integrator with margins compressing (profit +19% on sales +31%) and an unrelated move into safety equipment, which signals the core business lacks reinvestment room. CFO unknown and disclosure light.

CRIZAC.reason: Asset-light and cash-generative at ~12x, but 97% UK revenue, a Q1 FY27 decline and a 100% OFS IPO (promoters sold at the peak). Some UK policy risk looks priced in; the cliff risk remains.

KRISHNADEF.reason: Defence theme priced at ~47x FY26 while the order book fell from 1.3x to 0.4x revenue in a year. Promoter stake is slipping and indigenisation brings more special-steel vendors. Little margin of safety.

544150.reason: Growth is largely KP Group captive capex. Related-party pricing and receivables are unquantified, D/E is 1.35 and it is SME-listed. The 8x P/E likely reflects a group-governance discount, not mispricing.

TAC.reason: A Rs 57 Cr revenue base lifted by two partner deals; H2 profit fell 31% and FIIs went from 3.8% to zero. At ~28x it competes with Tenable and Qualys without disclosed ARR or retention data.

DYCL.reason: RDSS-dependent discom demand nears its timeline and CFO/PAT is ~0.6, but the 19% post-Q4 drop has already de-rated it and H1 FY27 PAT is tracking above FY26. Confirm why the ratings were withdrawn.

GANDHITUBE.reason: The screen penalises slow growth, but a debt-free niche at a ~41% operating margin, a buyback, a dividend and a promoter anti-pledge pact suggest durable quality. Strip out other income and confirm CFO first.

ARROWGREEN.reason: FY26 is a trough year from lumpy security orders while Green grew 52% and the patents are real. The screen's backward growth metric may understate it, but the Q1 rebound is unverified and promoters are selling.

APCOTEXIND.reason: Profit doubled on flat sales, so this is a cyclical margin recovery that rests on NBR anti-dumping duties. Q4 one-offs understate FY26 and capex adds operating leverage, but the TTM P/E already reflects much of it.

MODISONLTD.reason: A 49% ROCE and 15.6x are measured on silver-inflated FY26 profit (+194%), so 'normalised' is not normal. A silver reversal unwinds inventory gains. The underlying switchgear-contact moat deserves a separate, ex-silver valuation.

SOTL.reason: Ranked last on a normalised 24.5x, yet it is a debt-free transformer-oil leader tied to the grid build-out. The real issue is the Savita GreenTec promoter-entity merger terms, not the multiple. Base-oil cyclicality caps conviction.

overall: The screen rewards recent acceleration, so several top names sit near cyclical or policy peaks: Gulshan (ethanol allocations), Modison (silver), SRM (EPC margins) and Krishna Defence (a defence theme with a shrinking order book). Frontier and Jeena Sikho score well, but single-buyer dependence and unexplained margins with weak cash conversion make them verification cases, not conviction cases. KP Green and Unified Data-Tech carry governance and capital-allocation flags that low P/Es do not offset. Penalised names deserve a second look: Gandhi Special Tubes (quality and capital return), Arrow Greentech (trough year) and Savita (grid exposure, with merger diligence first). Across the board, unverified CFO is the biggest gap; resolve it before ranking.
